name: @localixai/desktop-tauri
description: Localix desktop shell — Tauri host, API sidecar, updater, and platform packaging.

scripts.//: Scripts are namespaced (tauri:*) on purpose: a bare `build`/`dev`/`lint` task
scripts.//2: would be picked up by `turbo build`/`turbo dev`/`turbo lint` across the workspace
scripts.//3: and fail on machines without Rust. Run these directly from this folder.
scripts.//4: `tauri:check` is the exception that IS safe to wire into a dedicated turbo task:
scripts.//5: it stages its own sidecar precondition and skips (exit 0) without a Rust toolchain.
scripts.//6: `test` IS a bare turbo task, and safe to be one: the suite is pure JS over
scripts.//7: tauri.conf.json + the plugin manifests — it touches no Rust and no toolchain.
